business_summary: Beijing Labtech Instruments Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies laboratory analytical products and solutions to laboratory industry worldwide. The company offers inductively coupled plasma spectrometers, atomic absorption spectrometer, atomic fluorescence spectrometer, fully automated iodine analyzer, and direct mercury analyzer; liquid chromatography system; and microplastics and elemental analysis system. It also provides microwave digestion/extraction system, super microwave chemist platform, fully automatic dilution and labeling instruments, fully automatic acid backflow cleaning system, automated acid purification system, microwave synthesis, ashing, rapid solve extraction, solvent-free natural product extraction system, and fat analyzer; solid phase extraction system, parallel concentration, fully automatic vacuum parallel concentrator, nitrogen generator, sweep and capture series, gel purification system, thermolytic series, thermal analysis series, organic sample pretreatment solution, intelligent laboratory solution, and auxiliary devices; and digester, micro-controlled digit display electric heating plate, circulating water cooler, intelligent rotary evaporator, vacuum pump, air compressor, intelligent anti-corrosion vibrating water bath, light wave heating device, soundproof enclosure, acid removal device, magnetic heating stirrer, and digital vacuum controller. In addition, the company offers clean and environmentally friendly laboratory solutions, as well as laboratory consumables, such as atomizer, electric heating digestion consumables, fog chamber, torch tube, coil, ICP-MS cone, temperature-controlled mist chamber, flow sensor, online sample filter, online gas check valve, atomizer cleaning tools, online label adding kit, argon humidifier, and laser ablation connector. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
